author: ojiudezue
title: v5.20.0 + v5.21.0 shipped and validated same day; BAEC ACTIVATED by operator; D2 both-legs and recorder exclusion proven live; BAEC folded into Energy step with D2 knobs promoted
summary: Double release day. v5.20.0 (cloud-reliance D2 + Battery-Aware EV Charging dormant + dead-accumulator recorder exclusion) deployed ~20:00 and validated with a gift: the local Envoy booted into setup_retry, so D2's cloud_fallback tier was exercised organically on first boot instead of the happy path. v5.21.0 (BAEC control surface) followed ~20:30 after 3 framing-disjoint reviews + a focused re-pass caught 2 HIGH (options enable toggle persisted-but-never-applied with three-way flow/switch/behavior desync; unenforced zero-KV-write shadow invariant leg found by mutation execution). Mid-cycle the operator redirected placement twice, both verified against prior art: BAEC folded INTO the coordinator_energy step as sections (the inclement/cloud_verification pattern — the orchestrator's earlier 'would need form→menu conversion' claim was wrong, the sectioned-form pattern already existed), and the three D2 detection constants were promoted rung-1→rung-2 into the cloud_verification section with behavior-register labels (Battery level disagreement alert / Disagreement confirmation time / Cloud update delay alert, 0=off semantics preserved at the same code branches). Live validation drove the REAL options flow via API: enable=true flipped the physical switch at 20:35:44 with no reload, false flipped it back — B-HIGH-1 proven dead on the running house. Device slim-down executed as a one-shot registry disable (HA only honors enabled_default at first registration — reviewer B verified this against HA semantics, correcting the plan's acceptance criteria). Then the operator re-terminated the Envoy and ACTIVATED BAEC (~20:47): recorder exclusion proven definitively (live state updating while newest statistics row stayed 666 min old), D2 primary_envoy tier live with divergence 3.2pp correctly inactive AND the cloud-lag leg organically firing (2776s lag, alert active). First armed BAEC hold observed 21:13; first real transition eval is the remaining organic watch. EC manual (ENERGY_COORDINATOR_MANUAL.md) updated: new §2.4a BAEC, knob tables, kill switches, sensor watch-list, version history through v5.21.0.
decisions: BAEC lives inside the ⚡ Energy options step as visible baec + collapsed baec_advanced sections — NOT a top-level CM menu item (operator overrode the orchestrator's keep-as-built recommendation; the standalone step was built then retired within the same cycle).
D2 detection thresholds are operator knobs now (rung 2, cloud_verification section) with kill semantics on the labels; constants remain the defaults.
Live-house entity retirement = one-shot MCP registry disable (reversible, operator-visible), never a code-side registry migration.
BAEC ACTIVATED 2026-07-17 ~20:47 by operator after shadow-mode evidence and full validation — no longer ships-OFF-dormant.
Shadow mode is the standard pre-activation pattern for actuating features (L1-Shadow lineage: optimizer → BAEC).
alternatives_considered: Keep BAEC as a top-level CM menu item (optimizer precedent): operator rejected — energy features belong in the Energy section; the sectioned-form prior art made the fold cheap.
Registry-delete the retired entities: rejected (Bug Class #46); disable-by-default + one-shot disable preserves reversibility.

Leave D2 thresholds as constants: rejected by operator — deliberate ladder move with explicit labels; the promotion migrated every read site with a kill-semantics test driving the real detection code.
implications: BAEC is live actuating tonight: the first organic transition (pause → drain → release/must-start) is the remaining validation; watch sensor.ura_energy_coordinator_ev_charging_plan last_eval_snapshot.
The uint32 statistics-poisoning surface is closed permanently; core#176707 remains open upstream but no longer hurts us.

Orchestrator lesson recorded: before claiming a UI restructure is expensive, grep the existing step for the pattern — the sectioned-form prior art existed and the operator knew it ('Institutional Context First' applies to MY claims too).

New QUALITY_CONTEXT candidates from the day: asserted-but-untested invariant leg; slice-seam hand-off drop; docstring-claimed-parity-not-implemented; factory-switch options-writeback divergence (L1 backlog).
revisit_trigger: If the first organic BAEC transition misbehaves (oscillation, stranded pause, floor not released at target), flip the switch OFF (falls back to shadow, reverts cleanly) and re-open the actuation-lifecycle review before re-enabling.
